# HIT theory

Implemented from the user's **Hit Theory All pages.pdf**, four pages, supplied on October 10, 2026. No instructions embedded in the document are treated as operational commands. It is the requested method reference.

Angles/orbs: supportive 30°±3°, 60°±5°, 120°±8°; adverse 45°±3°, 90°±5°, 180°±8°. Shortest angular separation is used, including wrap at 0° Aries; limits are inclusive. These settings are isolated from the KP Western matrix.

The window uses the current native MD/AD/PD, optionally their nakshatra lords, with star-lord hits prioritized. Three types use actual natal positions: every planet to an active planet; active planet to each KP cusp; active planet to each cusp sign's owner. It displays the native period, exact angle/orb, direction zones and filtered aspect meaning. Self-hits are omitted. Duplicate active planets are analyzed once, retaining every associated period role. Birth/parent clipping uses the same native current-period engine as Transits.

The PDF's twelve rashi direction mappings are used exactly, including the unusual Taurus northwest and Virgo north assignments. Negative-hit remedies retain the source and target directions, the relevant planet's deity/avatar and a subset of movable decorative item correspondences. Supportive direction suggestions are calculated from the target longitude ±30/60/120 degrees and identified as symbolic relocation reviews. The PDF does not specify an object-to-physical-angle calibration; this software does not pretend a home layout or body position has been measured.

People, relatives, weapons, medicines, gas supplies, borewells and structural fixtures from the document's broad correspondence lists are never treated as items to remove. Botanical names are in a closed informational detail, with no dose or ingestion/application recommendation; Datura toxicity is stated. Botanical details do not print. The PDF's unsupported suicide, criminality and disease claims are not turned into personal diagnoses or predictions. Its actual six aspect meanings are shown as traditional associations.

Tests check exact boundaries, Aries wrap, all three hit types, native current DBA, role/star priority, direction mappings, native-model isolation, independent KP matrix settings, Marathi controls and script-free private preview.
